modules.name: GENRA HIP-HOP
modules.description: A hip-hop beat generator in the look of an old production center: 29 styles from the 80s to the 2020s (Boom Bap to Trap), drums, bass, melody and pads, a sample chopped onto 16 playable pads with its chords and key found, a break chopped onto the drums, MIDI chop per track, MIDI export and the chops saved as WAVs
